# CBS Sports

> > CBS Sports provides comprehensive coverage of major professional and collegiate sports leagues with live scores, expert analysis, fantasy tools, and interactive bracket games.

CBS Sports is a leading sports news and information platform covering the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, college football, college basketball, soccer, golf, UFC, WWE, and more. The site features live game coverage, player statistics, standings, expert picks from analysts like Tom Brady and John Breech, and interactive tools like NCAA tournament bracket games.

## Key Topics

- NFL
- NBA
- MLB
- College Football
- College Basketball
- NCAA Tournament
- March Madness
- Live Scores
- Expert Picks
- Standings
- Game Recaps
- Player Injuries
- Free Agency
- Power Rankings
- Fantasy Sports

## Major Professional Leagues

- [NFL News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl): NFL news, scores, stats, standings and fantasy coverage with expert analysis
- [NBA News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/nba): NBA news, live scores, player stats, standings and fantasy basketball coverage
- [MLB News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/mlb): MLB news, scores, standings and coverage of spring training through playoffs
- [NHL News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/nhl): NHL news, live scores, standings, power rankings and playoff race coverage

## College Sports

- [College Football - NCAA Football News, Scores, Standings, Stats and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/college-football): College football news, scores, standings and recruiting coverage with CFP updates
- [College Basketball News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball): NCAA Division I men's basketball news, scores, stats and live game coverage
- [Women's College Basketball News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/womens-college-basketball): NCAA Division I women's basketball news, scores, stats and live coverage
- [2026 NCAA Men's Bracket Games](https://picks.cbssports.com/college-basketball/ncaa-tournament/bracket): Interactive NCAA tournament bracket game with expert picks and predictions

## Soccer & International Sports

- [Soccer News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer): Soccer news covering MLS, Premier League, Champions League and international play
- [Champions League News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/champions-league): UEFA Champions League news, scores, standings and European football coverage
- [NWSL News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/nwsl): NWSL news, scores, standings and women's soccer league coverage

## Combat Sports & Entertainment

- [UFC News, Events, Rankings and Results](https://www.cbssports.com/ufc): UFC fight coverage, news, rankings, results and event schedules
- [Boxing News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/boxing): Boxing news, fight results, championship titles and fighter rankings
- [WWE - News, Rumors, Results, and Videos](https://www.cbssports.com/wwe): WWE news, rumors, live results and event coverage including WrestleMania

## Women's Professional Sports

- [WNBA News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/wnba): WNBA news, scores, draft coverage and women's professional basketball standings

## Motor Sports & Specialty Leagues

- [NASCAR News - Live Race Coverage, Standings, and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/nascar): NASCAR news, live race coverage, standings and driver updates
- [Motor Sports News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/motor-sports): Motor sports coverage including Formula 1, IndyCar and motorsports standings
- [Golf News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/golf): PGA Tour golf news, leaderboards, tournament scores and player rankings
- [UFL News, Scores, Stats, Standings and Rumors](https://www.cbssports.com/ufl): UFL spring football news, scores, standings and expert picks
